up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, indication label (efo_term), and max phase for that indication (max_phase_for_ind) for all compounds that are approved (max_phase = 4) and indicated for chronic kidney disease. Filter the drug_indication table where efo_term or mesh_heading matches 'chronic kidney disease' (case-insensitive). Join molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, and drug_indication on molregno. Return distinct rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%chronic kidney disease%' OR LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%chronic kidney disease%')
